written_by: Claude Opus 5.5 (large model), Nov 14 2026. First draft, not yet checked against small-model results.
about: Short procedures a small model can follow. Kept few and general on purpose: retrieving too many hurts small models.

procedures.title: When memory notes disagree
procedures.body: Notes about the same thing can disagree because things change. Trust the note with the latest date. Mention the older value only if asked what it used to be.

procedures.title: When the answer is not in memory
procedures.body: If no note states the answer, say you don't know. Do not guess a value. If a note is close but about a different thing, say so.

procedures.title: How to file something new
procedures.body: Give it a short title naming the thing. Put it on an existing shelf if one fits (area/topic); make a new shelf only for a new area. If it states one value of one thing that can change (a code, a place, a date, a setting), give it a key 'thing|attribute' so a later value replaces it.

procedures.title: Answering about tasks
procedures.body: Only count tasks that are still open. The next task is the open one due soonest; if two are due the same day, the higher priority goes first. A moved task counts at its new date.

procedures.title: Finding something that was stored
procedures.body: Search with the most specific words first (names, numbers, unusual words). If nothing fits, try other words for the same thing, then browse the shelf it would be on.
